objects.query: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Type, BillingCity, BillingCountryCode, Phone, Website, AnnualRevenue FROM Account WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365 ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Title, AccountId FROM Contact WHERE Account.CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365 LIMIT 600
SELECT Id, Name, StageName, CloseDate, Amount, Type, AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE Account.CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365 LIMIT 600
SELECT Id, Subject, Status, Priority, Origin, AccountId, ContactId FROM Case WHERE Account.CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:365 LIMIT 300
